svg.title: Kanxeo Architecture (as of Phase 40)
svg.desc: Kanxeo hardware/workload orchestration platform architecture: REST-only client surfaces (kanxeoctl CLI, web dashboard, the PID1-spawned physical console) talking to the kanxeod daemon, which is the sole process with direct access to the container runtime library and every host/network/DNS/PKI/package/exec primitive (API-First Mandate, ADR-0005). Below the daemon: the container runtime it drives -- including a hand-rolled WebSocket exec/console session into a running container (ADR-0043), a root+intermediate PKI CA tier (ADR-0046/0047), and stateless host-side per-container stats read straight off cgroups/veth (ADR-0054) -- and the A/B boot / on-disk layout it manages as host PID 1.
svg.text: Hardware & workload orchestration platform — client-daemon, REST-first, hand-rolled from source (docs/mission/MISSION.md) — as of Phase 40
CLIENT SURFACES — pure REST clients, zero direct runtime access (ADR-0005)
scp's new OS/package images onto the box
out-of-band — no registry, no remote fetch
kanxeod — THE ONLY PROCESS WITH RUNTIME/NETWORK/DNS/PKI/PKG ACCESS
kanxeod — single-threaded, non-blocking epoll reactor (ADR-0007, ADR-0009)
hand-rolled HTTP/1.1 + JSON, no external libraries, dynamically linked against system glibc, TCC-compiled
Container Runtime Library (include/container.h) — linked directly into kanxeod only
CONTAINERS — each its own namespaces + cgroup, driven by kanxeod, never by CLI/web directly
exists as a REST endpoint FIRST.
HOST OS — kanxeod itself as real PID 1, no initramfs (Phase 11)
Read-only squashfs A/B root, systemd-boot's native boot counting (ADR-0014)
One boots, one is the write target for
the NEXT update — never touched live
net.conf — static IP applied at boot
falls back to tmpfs if absent
own QEMU test target and the
Reflects Phase 39: interactive container console over a hand-rolled WebSocket (ADR-0043); PID1-spawned physical console (ADR-0034).
Root+intermediate PKI CA tier and site-scoped DNS/PKI naming (ADR-0046/0047, ADR-0049 through ADR-0053); stateless host-side per-container stats (ADR-0054).
Reflects Phase 40: container file-read endpoint (ADR-0055); the hostbuild artifact mechanism, a second pkg-install mode writing to artifacts/ instead of an image (ADR-0056);
and self-hosted rebuild — kanxeod builds its own successor (tcc.recipe/kanxeo.recipe) and assembles a fresh squashfs itself, server-side, via a spawned mkbootroot (ADR-0057).

REST-driven ISO assembly (ADR-0064): POST /system/iso spawns mkinstalleriso the same server-side way, using a self-built isotools hostbuild artifact — closing the one API-First gap ADR-0063 left open.
Source of truth for what shipped: docs/roadmap/ROADMAP.md — for why: docs/adr/. Update this diagram whenever a change alters a box or arrow shown here (CLAUDE.md).
